objective: Eliminate benign 54000/HTTP 500 version-telemetry failures when user reaches 20 random reinstall IDs without ever weakening account or OTA security.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Live BUKLOD Connect Supabase 2026-11-12 16 HTTP 500 version registry errors and one account with 20 installation records. Exact current production SQL function inspected, Main source baseline 5a97b754b6e0319690a717461bdd182b7b132b0c separately verified; Main is not assumed live OTA.
chosenApproach: Serialize reports by authenticated user with xact advisory lock; at capacity delete exactly one oldest same-user telemetry row and then insert new ID, preserving 20-row cap.
selectionRationale: Simple bounded rolling window is safer than raising 500 or unbounded storage; IDs are not auth tokens, user account data or evidence for account bans.
alternativeApproaches: Increase installation limit indefinitely: rejected due unbounded DB growth and false monitoring.
Return 200 but discard newest report: rejected because current runtime adoption would remain invisible.
Rotate oldest same-user observation atomically after count>=20: selected.
acceptanceChecks: Engine accountability and Performance R1 QA pass
SQL transaction dry-run compiles unchanged function signature
Only oldest same-user registry record rotates when 20 cap reached
Anon denied; auth required; OBSERVE_ONLY OTA adoption unchanged
Production function parity verified after merge; no Android media changes
preserveBehaviors: No change to account RLS, auth, installation ownership and 20 max rows
No enforcement of old client cutoff via self-reported telemetry
No change to media playback, native runtime, ads or user points
No prod deployment until required CI release gates pass
releaseStatus: DEV only. Live DB migration separately gated.
